rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.

assertingTests.name: an Exorcist skip resolves the Pukka's previous kill without a new poison (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-PUKKA-03, BMR-PUKKA-06)
a Shabaloth blocked after prior choices still regurgitates last night's target (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-SHABALOTH-01)
an Exorcist who chooses the Demon closes its step, and a poisoned or Goon-drunk Exorcist does not (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-GOON-01)
an Exorcist who chooses the Shabaloth leaves it only the regurgitation, and one who chooses the Pukka resolves its waiting death (BMR-EXORCIST-01)
a Demon kept asleep gets the note the role wrote, and a Demon whose step is finished only the log line (BMR-EXORCIST-01)
a healthy Exorcist who chooses the Demon records the choice and keeps the Demon asleep (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-EXORCIST-02)
an Exorcist-blocked Zombuul still survives its first death (ROLE-EXORCIST-005)

rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.

assertingTests.name: the Exorcist cannot resolve a Pukka death scheduled for a later night (BMR-EXORCIST-02)
the Devil's Advocate has a step on every night and the Exorcist from the second night, with last night's choice barred (BMR-DEVILSADVOCATE-02, BMR-EXORCIST-02)
an Exorcist who chooses a player who is not the Demon records the choice and blocks nobody (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-EXORCIST-02)
an impaired Exorcist stops nobody but the choice is recorded (BMR-EXORCIST-01, BMR-EXORCIST-02)
